notes.text:
This update for xorg-x11-server fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-33999: XKB Integer Underflow in XkbSetCompatMap() (bsc#1260922).
- CVE-2026-34000: XKB Out-of-bounds Read in CheckSetGeom() (bsc#1260923).
- CVE-2026-34001: XSYNC Use-after-free in miSyncTriggerFence() (bsc#1260924).
- CVE-2026-34002: XKB Out-of-bounds read in CheckModifierMap() (bsc#1260925).
- CVE-2026-34003: XKB Buffer overflow in CheckKeyTypes() (bsc#1260926).

notes.text: A flaw was found in the X.Org X server. This integer underflow vulnerability, specifically in the XKB compatibility map handling, allows an attacker with local or remote X11 server access to trigger a buffer read overrun. This can lead to memory-safety violations and potentially a denial of service (DoS) or other severe impacts.
